verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਤੜੇ ਸਾਧ ਵਖਾਣੀਅਨਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: kitaRe saadh vakhaaneean saadhasa(n)gat vich paraupakaaree|

en.bdb: Many sadhus are there who move in the holy congregation and are benevolent.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੜਿਆਂ ਲਖ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਕੇਤੜਿਆਂ ਨਿਜ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: ketaRiaa(n) lakh sa(n)t jan ketaRiaa(n) nij bhagat bha(n)ddaaree|

en.bdb: Millions of saints are there who continuously go on filling the coffers of their devotion.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੜਿਆਂ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: ketaRiaa(n) jeevan mukat braham giaanee braham veechaaree|

en.bdb: Many are liberated in life; they have knowledge of Brahm and meditate upon Brahm.
Many are egalitarians and many more are spotless, clean and followers of the formless Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਤੜੇ ਲਖ ਬਿਬੇਕੀਆਂ ਕਿਤੜੇ ਦੇਹ ਬਿਦੇਹ ਅਕਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: kitaRe lakh bibekeeaa(n) kitaRe dheh bidheh akaaree|

en.bdb: Many are there with analytical wisdom; many are body less though they have bodies i.e. they are above the desires of body.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੈ ਵਰਤਣਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਬੈਰਾਗ ਸਵਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: bhai bhagat bhai varatanaa sahaj samaadh bairaag savaaree|

en.bdb: They conduct themselves in loving devotion and make equipoise and detachment their vehicle to move around.
Erasing ego from the self, gurmukhs obtain the fruits of the supreme delight.
